# Telegram

> Telegram is a cloud-based messaging platform hosting public channels for OSINT analysis, geopolitical intelligence, military operations reporting, and cryptocurrency trading communities.

This collection focuses on Telegram's public channels (t.me/s/) covering real-time intelligence from sources like SITREP, Counter Intelligence Global, and Oracle Meta Technologies. Content spans conflict zones including Ukraine, Israel, Lebanon, Iraq, and Baghdad with emphasis on open-source intelligence gathering and military analysis.

## Key Topics

- OSINT (Open Source Intelligence)
- SITREP
- Geopolitics
- Ukraine conflict
- Israel-Lebanon operations
- Middle East conflict
- Iraq attacks & U.S. Embassy Baghdad
- Counter Intelligence Global (CIG)
- Military operations
- Russia-Ukraine war
- Islamic Resistance in Iraq
- C-RAM defense systems
- Cryptocurrency trading
- Algorithmic trading bots
- Breaking news channels

## OSINT & Intelligence Channels

- [SITREP - Independent OSINT Channel (Lugansk Missile Attack)](https://t.me/s/sitreports/8580): SITREP OSINT report on Lugansk missile attack & ADM-160B decoys
- [SITREP - Independent OSINT Channel (Gaza City Operations)](https://t.me/s/sitreports/17538): SITREP OSINT coverage of Gaza City operations & conflict intelligence
- [SITREP - Independent OSINT Channel (Russia-Ukraine War)](https://t.me/s/sitreports/15013): SITREP OSINT analysis of Russia-Ukraine war & defense production
- [SITREP - Independent OSINT Channel (Belgorod Operations)](https://t.me/s/sitreports/24798): SITREP OSINT military updates on Russia-Ukraine Belgorod operations
- [Counter Intelligence Global](https://t.me/s/CIG_telegram): Counter Intelligence Global geopolitics & Middle East conflict updates

## Cryptocurrency & Trading

- [Oracle Meta Technologies](https://t.me/s/officialOMT): Oracle Meta Technologies crypto trading products & ecosystem updates
